spans.text: 2 hours 15 minutes until the Nidhogg Protocol takes full effect.
Bang-bang-bang!
The air resounds with fierce gunfire...
The number of Dolls still fighting has dwindled considerably.
Commander, we have confirmed the elimination of Bramedb and Styx.
DEFY and 404 are pursuing Hebe, while Morridow's whereabouts remain unknown...
Keep pursuing Morridow. Leave no one alive.
Yes, Commander.
AR Team, with me.
Roger!
...Click.
The Commander unlocks the safety on their handgun while cautiously advancing toward the operating theater.
Why don't you strike back?
Morridow sits slumped, her body covered in horrific wounds.
She tries to look toward Lunasia at the end of the hallway.
You'll resurrect me, won't you?
...You'll keep your promise, right?
...Promise?
I did everything you asked!
What more do you want from me?!
You've done very well, Morridow.
Now comes the time for your reward.
Quick, grant me immortality!
No, that's not it.
Lunasia slowly approaches Morridow, who instinctively shrinks back.
I told you I would take you across to the other side. This is it.
Lunasia places her palm on Morridow's head, gently stroking it as if coaxing a sulking pet.
Realizing her fate, Morridow trembles and weeps.
...You liar!!!
You're just like your brother! You're both liars!!!
The so-called holy maiden, the so-called savior—aren't these merely figures woven with illusions and lies to deceive followers?
Liar! Liar!!!
Hush now... Quietly move on to the other side...
I curse you! I curse you a—
Crack.
Morridow's head droops to one side at a grotesque angle.
Her tear-streaked face remains twisted with rage and despair. Lunasia gazes at her with feigned pity.
Then she turns leisurely, looking back at the silent Commander and the AR Team with their raised guns.
...Who exactly are you now?
At what point should I base my answer on, I wonder?
Perhaps it's best to start from when we last saw each other...
Bang—the fluorescent light bursts overhead, raining shards all over the room.
I want to see the Commander! Right now!!!
Snap. The cup of warm water shatters in her hand, leaving only one sharp piece of glass.
Lunasia presses it to her neck.
Miss Lunasia, please calm down.
I heard your request loud and clear—I'll report this to the Commander immediately.
But please, put the glass down first...
Do it now.
Her trembling hand presses the shard deeper. Dark red blood seeps out, creeping slowly along her pale neck to her collarbone...
This sensation of bleeding... She feels a mix of pain and pleasure.
Just like that woman in her dreams...
Lunasia flashes a cruel smile.
Commander. Commander, right. I'll contact the Commander right away!
XM556 calls the Commander in front of Lunasia.
After receiving the Commander's permission, XM556 turns back toward her.
Please come with me, Miss Lunasia. I'll escort you to the Commander.
Clang.
The blood-stained shard falls to the floor.
Lunasia beams happily and follows XM556 out of the safe house without protest.
Two sets of footsteps echoed dully down the empty street in the middle of the night.
Miss Lunasia, the car is just ahead by the roadside. I'll drive you to the Elmo.
Mm.
XM556 activated the vehicle and opened the passenger door for Lunasia.
Beep-beep. Lunasia's communicator rang.
Sister, do you like this gift I've given you?
...So this is the altar you chose?
This is the altar WE chose together. What we failed to complete back then can now begin anew.
...Will everyone die?
Except for the lucky ones who board the Ark.
Miss Lunasia?
Forgive me, XM556.
Lunasia takes her hand.
Wha—
XM556 collapses weakly onto Lunasia, who tosses her into the car.
Goodnight, XM556. Don't worry, I'd just like you to rest for a few days...
With wobbly steps, Lunasia walks alone into the distance...
Lunasia smiles at the Commander.
Before our last meeting, I was Lunasia.
...And now?
I am the true master served by the omniscient, omnipotent Laplace's Demon.
The key to the Relics, the nexus linking this world and the other.
An existence akin to God.
...But you have Dandelion's and M4's memories...
Yes. I also carry the memories of a human girl named Lunasia von Oberstein.
She is the subject of the final surgery inside here.
The final barrier standing in your way.
Lunasia claps her hands playfully.
Thud—
The Dolls of the AR Team behind the Commander collapse at once.
The Commander tightens their grip on their pistol.
What do you want?
...I want to have a proper chat with you.
Underground in the White Zone...
Lunasia leads the Commander into an old laboratory.
The cold air rushes in with the dust. The place, still unfinished, is left idle and unoccupied.
There are no Dolls to protect the Commander. After all, no Doll's protection would matter as the Commander faces Lunasia...
...Where should I begin, Commander?
I suppose I should start from when I was still Lunasia von Oberstein.
Since I was little, my mother had told me I would save humanity from its destined destruction, that I was the savior of this world.
Such was the honor... carried by the Oberstein bloodline.
...Savior?
My father never believed any of it. He always tried to stop my mother from telling me such things.
In his eyes, I was just a child who loved playing with dolls—how could I ever be the savior who determines the fate of humanity?
Later, my mother took me away from home, to the place where the believers gathered.
There, I became the "Holy Maiden".
Lunasia demonstrates the gesture people made when they worshipped her.
It seems to be a variation of a common religious gesture.
Those believers thought I could grant their wishes. They were willing to sacrifice their lives for it.
Even if you could... what would be the point if they're already dead?
There, everyone said I was the savior, that I had the power to save humankind.

A retired soldier who had lost his legs in the war sacrificed his loyal dog of many years. He believed his legs had grown back, though he still used a wheelchair. He claimed it was to remember the pain and suffering caused by of war.
A mother whose child had died from a fever sacrificed her own mother's life. Then holding her child's favorite doll, she told me her resurrected child was greeting me with a smile...
I asked my mother what all of this was for. She said it was all for me.
Even her own existence, she said, was for me.
She said only with enough blood and lives sacrificed could the door to a new world be opened.
But what my mother did not know... was that her “savior” was only a pious fantasy.
The fire of WWIII was a very real slaughter though.
Then, she sacrificed herself before my eyes.
She put poison strong enough to kill an elephant into everyone's drink, and watched as the believers drank.
Once she confirmed that only the two of us were left breathing, she screeched with demented laughter and drank what was left in front of me.
She believed this would end the war—and that I would become the "savior".
But nothing happened.
Instead, it was my father's arrival that truly changed "me".
He named this plan "Project Valkyrie", and its leader was the then "William".
...Then?
Yes. "William" was just a codename. I never learned that man's real name.
That "William" began forging me into his version of the savior—the Key to the Relics.
He thought only the Relics could save humankind, though he had no idea what they actually contained.
The Relics are like the highly sought-after treasure in all fairy tales—no one cares what it is; they simply must have it.
...That's absurd.
Yes, it is absurd, but it truly existed.
In the end, the girl named "Lunasia" went mad. She completely lost her mind as she went through experiment after experiment.
She also wanted the "treasure", but the only wish she made upon it was the destruction of all humankind.
The girl destined to be the savior wished to destroy the world. That was her dream.
...So who is the current "William"?
It's little Bill—her younger brother, Ballard von Oberstein.
Lunasia made a pact with Bill—no matter what form "Lunasia" took when she returned to this world, Bill would unlock the Relics and carry out his sister's wish—to destroy the world.
Lunasia and Bill agreed—he would become her anchor. As long as he lived, he would forever remind her of her true... and original wish.
Bill worked so hard for this that he even lost his own name.
He became the new "William".
And Laplace?
Laplace disliked the codename "William", even though she was actually closer to that role within Paradeus.
One could say, after the last "William" died, Bill had inherited the name, while Laplace inherited the duties.
That's why Bill must kill Laplace, to truly, fully inherit the position of "William".
...How sickening.
Lunasia seems unbothered by the Commander's remark. She simply looks at them with a faint smile.
Am I not telling the story well enough?
Your story is impressive, but hypocritical. You never mentioned any of their crimes.
Lunasia, William, Ballard, Laplace—they're all mad.
They put their desires and personal feelings above the fate of all humanity.
Why should their love and hatred be more significant than anyone else's?
Commander, you're angry. You find this incomprehensible.
Not because of the sins they'd committed, but because... this isn't your story. This doesn't concern your personal feelings or your fate.
...No! Even I—
Lunasia cuts them off.
Please be patient, Commander.
I'm about to tell you... your true story.
What?
...Why do you think Angelia chose to die willingly?
What do you mean?
Do you remember... what she said to you?
"In the end, we really are allies, Commander."
...Of course I remember.
That was when she asked me—
"Commander, what should we look to in order to save the world?"
"The past, the present, or the future?"
That was when we agreed on Operation Muromets...
But that was part of the expedition!
No, Commander.
Let me tell you the true meaning of those words.
It was the reason she underwent her final surgery. The entire truth that Embla told her.
Angelia chose to die willingly because this is not the only world.
Have you seen a spindle?
Fates and worlds are like threads upon it—they can have countless beginnings, countless branches, yet always converge on the same end.
Embla showed her two worlds—three stories that took place in this world, and one story from the other. In that world, Angelia chose to meet with Samosina first instead of Ulrich.
So she did not get captured at the mansion—but you died at the pharmaceutical plant.
Former allies became enemies. Former traitors became allies.
And that was only one of such other worlds.
...There are more?
Yes... You want to know M16's true mission, don't you?
It was her promise to M4.
Because in one of the other worlds, M4 and M16 had perished long ago in the Paldiski Submarine Base. You ended up fighting on the frontlines against the air raid as a mercenary—and died in Frankfurt.
In yet another world, you handed Machlian over, reached the mansion in time, and together with Angelia slew Gray and Morridow.
Then, just as things were going well in Berlin, you encountered the strongest Nyto and died on Unity Day.
Angelia took DEFY to avenge you, and died in Avernus.
Do you now understand the weight of her words, Commander?
"In the end, we really are allies, Commander."
Ange said that... because she's the only one...
That's right. Only the agent codenamed "Angelia"—in any world, by any choice—
Is, and always will be, your ally, Commander.
Something begins to blur the Commander's vision.
Then... all the more reason I must stop this surgery—stop "William"!
Not only for myself... but for Ange! For all the people who died in Frankfurt and at the hands of Paradeus!
In that case... the first life you must take...
...Is actually Miss Cornelia Schaefer's.
...What... the hell are you talking about?
Because she... is the next "William".
...That can't be!
We're the same kind of people!
She and I, like Ange, are comrades-in-arms who walk the same path!!
She personally avenged Gray!!!
She saved lives in Frankfurt!!!
You're lying... You've been lying right from the start!!!
Commander, turn on your tablet. I'll show you a scene from one of the other worlds.
...Gray Blackwell.
Do you remember her?
I expected as much. To you, to Griffin's Commander...
She was just an insignificant figure.
But to me...
She was my guiding light...
My admired senior...
And you killed her...
Each one of us in turn climbs the Calvary of the age.
Each one of us finds anew the agony, each one of us finds anew the desperate hope and folly of the ages.
Each one of us follows in the footsteps of those who were, of those before us who struggled with death, denied death—and are dead.
Impossible...
Impossible...
That can't be true...
If Angelia had not died in Avernus...
You would never have met Erma, Aliana, or RPK-16 as Embla...
And you would never have met the Miss Cornelia Schaefer that you know.
Today is Bohnsdorf Day, My Lady. Your arrival is truly a blessing from the Lord.
No, I am not the Lord's blessing. From today onward, I am your Lord.
...Big Sis is here to see you, Light.
I will avenge you...
I will avenge you with my own hands...
I will not apologize.
Erma is the cutest Doll.
So...
Erma refuses to become human.
I've already taken back everyone's things.
And you... Aliana... You don't matter anymore.
At least, not to me.
No...
This isn't real...
These are illusions, lies you've conjured...
"Nobody's sacrifice is without value."
"Because by relinquishing their lives, they will be giving the living something even more precious."
Those were M4's words to you.
Do you understand what she really meant by them now?
Do you know who was the strongest Nyto? You've actually met her...
Nemhran?
No, it was Grig, with modifications made by Miss Nele.
And who do you think is the strongest Doll?
AK-15
Wrong again. The strongest Doll...
...Is Amaris, reforged by Laplace for the sole purpose of killing Aliana.
And when Laplace handed Paradeus over to Miss Nele, she said...
Compared to Gray or William—you're more like me.
...True talent and passion... you're my best student.
...Knowledge is a curse.
...Talent is a curse.
One day, you'll admit... what you inherited from me is what you've been pursuing your whole life...
The passcode to the "Hela" project logs is...
...SFDSEGBWQE1345...
Well then, Commander?
Are you going to kill Miss Nele?
